name: Winter Wonderland Movie Night with The Grinch in Tamarac
host: City of Tamarac Parks and Recreation
when_note: Friday, December 11, sensory hour 5:30 PM, activities 6:30 PM, movie at 8 PM
paras: The City of Tamarac lists Winter Wonderland on Friday, December 11, 2026 as a holiday movie night featuring The Grinch on a big screen at Tamarac Park, and marks it a free family event.
The city's schedule starts with a sensory hour from 5:30 to 6:30 PM, then pre-movie activities at 6:30 PM and the movie at 8 PM.
Families can expect a DJ, a bounce house, food trucks and a festive holiday train ride, according to the city's event page.
The Tamarac Parks and Recreation listing is tagged for children and families.

name: Santa by Sea in Wilton Manors
paras: Santa by Sea sails on Monday, December 14, 2026 at 5:30 PM, and the city calendar entry for the cruise reads Free.
Santa and his elves leave from the Colohatchee Park boat ramp at 1975 NE 15th Ave for a festive cruise around the Island City.
The city invites families to come early to meet and greet Santa before he sets sail, or to wave from the waterfront along the route.
Boat owners who want to join the procession are asked to gather at the boat ramp 30 minutes before departure.

name: Wilton Wonderland at Hagen Park Community Center
paras: A Saturday morning party, Wilton Wonderland runs December 19, 2026 from 10 AM to noon inside the Hagen Park Community Center. Cost is free and all ages are welcome.
Santa, The Grinch and their holiday friends host a morning of storytime, arts and crafts, games, a petting zoo and a candy cane hunt.
The city encourages families to bring a camera for photos with Santa and The Grinch.

name: Wilton Manors Holiday Lighting Ceremony at Flippen Park
address: NE 21st Ct and Wilton Dr, Wilton Manors, FL 33305
paras: Flippen Park hosts the annual Holiday Lighting Ceremony on Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 6:30 PM, with free admission.
The ceremony lights the Holiday Menorah, the Kinara and the Wilton Manors Christmas tree in a celebration of the season.
The city lists live entertainment, food and local vendors, and family friendly holiday activities for all ages.

name: Christmas By-The-Sea in Lauderdale-By-The-Sea
paras: Discover Lauderdale-By-The-Sea, the town's tourism site, lists Christmas By-The-Sea on Wednesday, December 2, 2026 from 5 to 8 PM. The site describes its events page as covering events that are free and open to the public.
The town runs a Vendor Village for the evening and publishes a 2026 vendor application on the same page.
The town's events page asks visitors to use the public parking lots, and to request a ride on Circuit-By-The-Sea if they park a few blocks away.
